title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Maxell MX90 > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 02/2012
source: Source: SBD > ? > Lo-gen Cassette, kindly provided by Seaweed1010.

ai_review.summary: Excellent clean soundboard captures an underrated, high‑energy second set with a smoking Scarlet > Fire and shredding NFA.
ai_review.review: The second‑set performance is hailed as one of the most underrated gems of 1982, featuring a bouncy, jazzy jam on Scarlet > Fire, a fierce short‑but‑intense Eyes, and an out‑of‑space NFA that soars for over three minutes. The SBD source is praised for its crystal‑clear clarity and low hiss, making the recording sound as vibrant as the show itself.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give 4–5 stars, emphasizing both a stellar musical performance and an excellent, low‑hiss soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a killer clean SBD source with noticeably less hiss than comparable Millar boards; clear, balanced mix throughout the set.

standout_songs: Eyes of the World (short but fierce)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set flows with relaxed, jazzy jams reminiscent of late‑'70s shows; tight transitions and a standout spacey NFA segment.
